about: As case 211, but the earlier run's two units were started by the line's status tag, not by a comment; the writer added the comment after that run, asking for the line in both notes. This run's u1, for that comment, copies the line into idea-mara and into idea-tobias-rowing, the renamed note the earlier unit sent it to (under its old path). The earlier send was for another trigger, so the copy is the writer's new ask and passes: `record` exits 0, the run moves to verifying with fixing [u1]. Following the rename must not turn a different trigger's copy into a refusal.

readings: On the old code `record` accepts this copy too, since its guard never followed renames; the case fails there only on batches.json (the renamed copy handed back, no `renamed`). It guards the new code against over-refusing.
